integrity: All lower-layer and equality-layer exponent patterns are handled with exact rational abundancy bounds. The equality classification uses a monotone finite branch-and-bound proof whose complete checker is packaged with the result.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the minimum total-prime-factor multiplicity layer. It does not classify quadriperfect numbers with \(\Omega(n)\ge9\) or settle the completeness of the known quadriperfect list.
title: The first multiplicity layer of quadriperfect numbers
